scripts.dev: pnpm build:packages && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,worker,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta,green "pnpm --filter @chainport/api dev" "pnpm --filter @chainport/worker dev" "pnpm --filter @chainport/web dev"
scripts.build:packages: pnpm db:generate && tsc -b packages/shared packages/evm packages/chain-registry packages/scanner packages/compatibility packages/migration packages/changeset packages/sandbox packages/ingest packages/db
scripts.build:services: pnpm db:generate && tsc -b packages/shared packages/evm packages/chain-registry packages/scanner packages/compatibility packages/migration packages/changeset packages/sandbox packages/ingest packages/db apps/api apps/worker
scripts.test:integration: pnpm build:packages && node --env-file=.env.integration scripts/assert-integration-test-database.mjs && pnpm db:deploy:integration && node --env-file=.env.integration node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm db:generate && tsc -b packages/shared packages/evm packages/chain-registry packages/scanner packages/compatibility packages/migration packages/changeset packages/sandbox packages/ingest packages/db apps/api apps/worker --pretty false && pnpm --filter @chainport/web typecheck
